findings.title: Forbidden Diffie-Hellman group

evidence.expected: One of: MODP-3072, MODP-4096, MODP-6144, MODP-8192, ECP-384, ECP-521

findings.why_it_matters: MODP groups of 1536 bits or fewer give well under 112 bits of security. 1024-bit groups are within reach of well-resourced attackers through precomputation against common primes (the Logjam attack), which can expose the session keys, and RFC 8247 advises against them. This value was only offered, not agreed, so severity is one level lower than if it had been negotiated.
findings.remediation: Use a 2048-bit or larger MODP group, or an elliptic-curve group, in the IKE proposal on both peers. A proposal that satisfies policy 'cnsa-strict': AES-256-CBC / HMAC-SHA2-384 / ECP-384 (strongSwan swanctl.conf: proposals = aes256-sha384-ecp384).

findings.title: IKE negotiation failed
findings.why_it_matters: The tunnel was not established, so this session protects no traffic. A failure like NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN means the peers share no acceptable proposal. The risk is lost availability, and the temptation to loosen algorithms on the stricter side just to get the tunnel up. Responder error observed: NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN.
findings.remediation: Compare the IKE proposals configured on both peers and align them on a policy-approved proposal. Do not add legacy algorithms to the stricter peer to make the tunnel come up.

findings.title: Encryption algorithm not approved by policy
findings.why_it_matters: This cipher is not on the policy's approved list. It is not necessarily broken, but the selected policy only allows the listed algorithms and key lengths. This value was only offered, not agreed, so severity is one level lower than if it had been negotiated.
findings.remediation: Configure an approved cipher and key length in the IKE and ESP proposals. A proposal that satisfies policy 'cnsa-strict': AES-256-CBC / HMAC-SHA2-384 / ECP-384 (strongSwan swanctl.conf: proposals = aes256-sha384-ecp384).

findings.title: Integrity algorithm not approved by policy
findings.why_it_matters: This integrity algorithm is not on the policy's approved list. The selected policy only allows the listed algorithms. This value was only offered, not agreed, so severity is one level lower than if it had been negotiated.
findings.remediation: Configure an approved integrity algorithm in the IKE and ESP proposals. A proposal that satisfies policy 'cnsa-strict': AES-256-CBC / HMAC-SHA2-384 / ECP-384 (strongSwan swanctl.conf: proposals = aes256-sha384-ecp384).

posture.basis_note: The handshake did not complete, so this reflects the proposals that were offered, not an established tunnel.
